name: Contribution 1
definition: Provides additional information such as the contribution account identification or the requirement amount.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Segregation done by the central counterparty based on trading venues/products or other attributes.

RequiredAmount.name: Required Amount
RequiredAmount.definition: Total contribution required by the clearing member to participate to the default fund.

IncreaseCoverageAmount.name: Increase Coverage Amount
IncreaseCoverageAmount.definition: Additional amount that the clearing member will have to provide to cover a risk increase. This results from a risk management decision depending on central counterparty specific criteria.

NonClearingMember.name: Non Clearing Member
NonClearingMember.definition: Provides the identification for the non-clearing member.
